# Embassy of Ethiopia in London

> Official website of the Embassy of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia to the United Kingdom.

This site provides consular services guidance, diplomatic news, and information about Ethiopia for visitors and the Ethiopian community in the UK.

## Key pages

- [Home](/): Mission overview, news, and service entry points
- [Embassy News](/news): Official announcements and diplomatic updates
- [Consular Services](/consular-services): Visas, passports, legalization, and related services
- [Book Appointment](/booking): Online consular appointment booking
- [Contact Us](/contact-us): Address, phone, email, and office hours
- [The Ambassador](/the-ambassador): Head of Mission profile
- [About Ethiopia](/about-ethiopia): Country profile, culture, economy, tourism
- [Investment](/investment-overviews): Investment opportunities in Ethiopia
- [Search](/search): Site search

## Contact

- Address: 17 Princes Gate, London SW7 1PZ
- Phone: +44 20 7589 7212
- Email: london.embassy@mfa.gov.et
